assertion: Independent local owners accept their own work and actions.
meaning: The first Work returns evidence. The effect lane denotes separately authorized bounded work after a current Root packet, not permission for the first proposal. Repeat this local pattern for independent owners; no edge grants authority from one Root to another.
omitted_scope: Topology and time predicates, packet internals, Root descent and provider callbacks are not fully drawn.

rendering.layout: Two local-owner columns, VenueRoot left and ActivePlanetRoot right. Shared intention/proposal line above; time/memory and child Work context below.
text_flows: Each column: local Work result to its own Root review.
Left column: Permission/current packet to Firewall; then separate authorized execution.
Right column: foreign approval creates no registry write permission.
rendering.legend: Only the cross-owner DATA relation is a graphical arrow; local proposal, permission and execution relations are labelled in text. No SuperRoot.

assertion: The received body becomes local evidence, not transferred booking permission.
meaning: Producer E precedes review and B. Received B and authenticated STATUS produce C. Requester Work consumes C before local result review. Separate BOOK is outside this exchange. Revoked STATUS stops the positive consumption lane.
omitted_scope: Release/nonce/high-water checks are described in text; not all sixteen historical cases or full signature replay are depicted.

rendering.layout: E, B and C columns; negative status strip below; separate BOOK boundary at bottom.
text_flows: Address locates B; release binds delivery.
C belongs to ActivePlanetRoot Work and includes current STATUS; local result review follows.
REVOKED stops this positive consumption path. BOOK is a separate consent/action boundary.
rendering.legend: DERIVATION builds a different object; DATA transfers material for checked consumption, not permission. Other checks are text, not unlabelled graph edges.

assertion: Authoring and independent admission precede, rather than replace, runtime decisions.
meaning: SOURCE_ADMISSION is a separately authorized repository/source operation, deliberately distinct from runtime ROOT. The audit Reader explains evidence; it is not the HOW kit or the examiner oracle. G54D1 required an authorized fourth correction.
omitted_scope: No future cold author is given old hidden examiner answers. Source admission never grants current action permission.

rendering.layout: HOW + WHAT, candidate, independent exam, source admission above a distinct runtime band.
text_flows: The audit Reader is not the kit or hidden oracle.
The lower runtime band names request, current sources, Work, local Root and scoped effect; it does not share SOURCE_ADMISSION identity.
rendering.legend: DOCUMENT_REFERENCE supplies authoring inputs, DATA submits a candidate, PROPOSAL supports separate source admission.
